name: 90061 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90061 (Los Angeles) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90061 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90061 (Los Angeles) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
